parsed.summary: The PR addresses a specific issue with version comparison but introduces a regex-based solution that may not fully resolve all edge cases.

issues.description: The regex-based solution may not handle all versioning schemes correctly, potentially leading to functional incompleteness.
The code introduces a new import (`re`) without updating the docstring, which could be considered a maintainability issue.
